description: The bar chart illustrates the Token Ratio (TR) performance across six evaluation categories—PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG—comparing three models: RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). The horizontal axis lists the evaluation categories, while the vertical axis represents the TR score, ranging from 0 to 1.00, with values labeled atop each bar. In every category, the light gray bar (SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 base) reaches the maximum score of 1.00, serving as the baseline. The dark blue bar (RedWhale) and light blue bar (EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0) show lower scores: for PT-EVAL, RedWhale scores 0.42 and EEVE scores 0.46; for KoBEST-BQ, 0.52 and 0.56; for KoBEST-CP, 0.71 and 0.74; for KoBEST-HS, 0.50 and 0.54; for KoBEST-SN, 0.69 and 0.73; and for AVG, 0.57 and 0.61, respectively. The chart visually emphasizes that while RedWhale and EEVE underperform relative to the base model in all categories, EEVE consistently outperforms RedWhale, with the largest gap observed in KoBEST-CP (0.74 vs. 0.71) and the smallest in PT-EVAL (0.46 vs. 0.42). The bars are grouped by category, with consistent color coding indicated in the legend below.
